hypothesis_title: SAM's NLL gain beyond temperature scaling

strands.why: Raw NLL -0.098 and ECE -0.038 vs SGD; NLL -0.021 vs temp-scaled SGD (Holm p=0.003); ECE vs TS-SGD +0.0005 mixed; SAM under-fit (train loss 0.107 vs 0.008).
n=3, lr 0.03, no p-values: ECE 0.028 vs 0.045 at epoch 60, shrinks to 0.007 vs 0.009 under temp scaling; matched-loss ECE gap 0.010-0.014; epoch-5 no consistent sign.

hypothesis_title: SAM's NLL edge: real but unisolated

strands.why: NLL -0.033 vs TS-SGD (Holm p=0.0018) at tuned SGD lr 0.001; shuffled-label NLL gap -0.224 exceeds true gap; ECE/ACE vs TS-SGD not significant.
Matched-loss SGD at lr 0.01: raw NLL -0.0125, TS-NLL -0.0082, raw ECE -0.0076, TS-ECE null, accuracy Holm p=0.055; placebo fails for NLL and ECE.
Reanalysis only, no new training: 3-seed gap peaks at epochs 25-30 then narrows; p-values descriptive; no test of growth with length.
